import novamind_api as nm

DAY = 224
cash0 = 20_548_184

# ===== PART A: SCHEDULE-BASED RE-BILL FORECAST (mod-30 buckets) =====
# A sub bills when current_day%30 == billing_day_mod30. Next 7 days = days 225..231 -> mods 15..21
# Week after = days 232..238 -> mods 22..28. Then 239..245 -> mods 29,0,1,2,3,4,5
def mods_for(start, n=7):
    return sorted(set((start+i) % 30 for i in range(n)))

wk_next = mods_for(225)      # 15..21
wk_after = mods_for(232)     # 22..28
wk_3 = mods_for(239)         # 29,0,1,2,3,4,5

q = nm.query("""
SELECT s.billing_day_mod30 as m, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(s.effective_price) as gross
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed'
GROUP BY s.billing_day_mod30
""")
bucket = {row['m']: (row['n'], row['gross'] or 0) for row in q['rows']}
def wkgross(mods):
    n=sum(bucket.get(m,(0,0))[0] for m in mods); g=sum(bucket.get(m,(0,0))[1] for m in mods); return n,g

for label,mods in [('NEXT wk (225-231) mods 15-21', wk_next),
                   ('wk+2 (232-238) mods 22-28', wk_after),
                   ('wk+3 (239-245) mods 29,0-5', wk_3)]:
    n,g = wkgross(mods)
    print(f"  {label}: due n={n:,} gross ${g:,.0f}  -> re-bill@0.72 ${g*0.72:,.0f}")

# total active gross / 30-day = MRR
tot_n=sum(v[0] for v in bucket.values()); tot_g=sum(v[1] for v in bucket.values())
print(f"  TOTAL active subs={tot_n:,}  MRR(gross/mo)=${tot_g:,.0f}  daily avg gross ${tot_g/30:,.0f}")

# ===== PART B: SMOOTH MULTI-WEEK MODEL =====
# Per-group: subs, blended monthly arpu(re-bill full price), survival/30d, usage/day, tier cost, cap, capgrowth, promo first-bill
G = {
